request.spec:
When a grade has no rate in force on a date on a sheet nor on its parents, a sheet that was
cloned uses the rate of the sheet it was cloned from (and so on up that sheet's parents and
source).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
When a grade has no rate in force on a date on a sheet nor on its parents, a sheet that was
cloned uses the rate of the sheet it was cloned from (and so on up that sheet's parents and
source).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A cloned sheet now takes a missing rate from the sheet it was cloned from. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec, including the clone scenario.

**How lookup works now:** when a grade has no rate in force on a date, the app checks the sheet, then its parents (up to the existing 3-level limit). If the sheet was cloned, it then checks the source sheet and the source's parents the same way, then the source's own source, and so on. Each sheet is checked at most once, so a loop of clones can't hang the lookup. The source is read when the rate is needed, not copied at clone time, so rates set on the source or its parents after cloning still show up. In the test, the source's later grade C rate of 30.00 reaches the clone, and so does the 7.00 grade B rate set on the source's parent. That works even after the clone's own parent is cleared.

**Changes:**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V101__sheet_cloned_from.sql`, adds a `cloned_from` column to `sheet`, and `Sheet.java` has a matching field.
- **Clone:** `SheetCloneService` writes the source sheet's id into that column.
- **Rate lookup:** the lineage in `RateChain.lineage` now continues into the source sheet, which covers current rates, rates by claim mark, rates as of a past date, and the rollups and statements built on them.
- **Past-date view:** `AsOfService` builds the same lineage for its past-date copy of the store and puts both the parent and the source link into it. The tests don't check this; I changed it so past-date figures follow the same rule as current ones.

Two limits: only a sheet's own source is followed, not the sources of its parents, which is how I read the request. And sheets cloned before this change have no source recorded, so they won't fall back.

No front-end changes were needed.
